extracted.intended_audience: Principal Investigators, co-PIs, institutional research administrators, and prospective NSF proposers
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for preparing, submitting, and administering proposals and awards for NSF assistance programs (proposal formatting, required sections, eligibility, merit review criteria, budget/allowable costs, and post-award responsibilities).

rubrics_metrics.name: Conformance with Instructions for Proposal Preparation
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposals must conform to the PAPPG proposal preparation and submission guidelines; deviations require explicit authorization.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The coverage provides guidance for preparation and submission; some NSF programs have solicitations that modify general provisions and those solicitation guidelines must be followed. Authorization to deviate may be requested where noted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proposal Format (pagination, font, spacing, margins)
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposals must meet NSF page formatting requirements (pagination, font, spacing, and margin requirements).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow specified page formatting instructions exactly; failure to comply can lead to non-acceptance or return without review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proposal Contents and Required Sections
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposals must include specified sections (Cover Sheet, Project Summary, Table of Contents, Project Description, References Cited, Biographical Sketches, Budget and Budget Justification, Current and Pending Support, Facilities/Resources, Special Information and Supplementary Documentation, Appendices as allowed).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each section has distinct content and possible page limits; include single-copy documents where required and ensure all required elements are present.

rubrics_metrics.name: Project Summary requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: A Project Summary is required as part of the proposal.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Project Summary content and expectations are set by PAPPG (including addressing merit review criteria in appropriate solicitations); ensure it meets any stated content and format rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Project Description content, page limits, and URLs
rubrics_metrics.description: The Project Description must provide the narrative of the proposed activity and comply with page limitations and rules regarding inclusion of URLs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Observe the Project Description page limit; inclusion of URLs is restricted and may be disallowed from substituting for required content in the Project Description.

rubrics_metrics.name: Results from Prior NSF Support
rubrics_metrics.description: When applicable, proposals must include Results from Prior NSF Support.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide past NSF support details per PAPPG instructions; may be required for certain renewal or resubmission proposals.

rubrics_metrics.name: References Cited
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposals must include a References Cited section listing bibliographic citations supporting the proposal.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Format citations per PAPPG expectations and include all references necessary to evaluate the proposal.

rubrics_metrics.name: Biographical Sketches (senior personnel elements)
rubrics_metrics.description: Biographical sketches for senior personnel must include professional preparation, appointments, products, and synergistic activities, among required elements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow the PAPPG-specified biographical sketch format and content; include only the allowed information and adhere to page limits.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget and Budget Justification (components and policies)
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposals must present a detailed budget and justification covering salaries and wages, fringe benefits, equipment, travel (general/domestic/foreign), participant support, consultant services, computer services, subawards, other direct costs, and indirect (F&A) costs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Adhere to NSF salary/wage policies (including Senior Personnel and administrative/clerical policies), provide reasonable and allocable costs, and include confidential budgetary information only where appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Salaries & Wages Policy (senior and administrative/clerical)
rubrics_metrics.description: Policies govern charging salaries & wages for senior personnel and administrative/clerical staff to NSF awards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow PAPPG procedures and documentation expectations for when administrative/clerical salaries can be charged and for how senior personnel effort is justified.

rubrics_metrics.name: Allowability of Costs (basic considerations and examples)
rubrics_metrics.description: Costs must be allowable, allocable, and reasonable under applicable cost principles; certain costs are specifically unallowable or limited.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: PAPPG lists examples of unallowable items (entertainment, meals/coffee breaks in many cases, alcoholic beverages, home office, etc.) and special prohibitions (e.g., certain telecommunications/video surveillance equipment). Prior written approvals may be required for some costs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prohibition on Certain Telecommunications and Video Surveillance Services/Equipment
rubrics_metrics.description: NSF prohibits costs for certain telecommunications and video surveillance services or equipment as specified by policy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not include costs for prohibited equipment/services; consult PAPPG for specific prohibited items and exceptions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Current and Pending Support
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposals must disclose current and pending support for senior personnel and the project.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide complete and accurate information on commitments and overlaps to allow NSF to assess resource availability and avoid duplication of funding.

rubrics_metrics.name: Facilities, Equipment and Other Resources
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposals must describe available facilities, equipment, and other resources that will support the project.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide sufficient detail to demonstrate institutional support and adequacy of resources; this information helps assess project feasibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Postdoctoral Researcher Mentoring Plan
rubrics_metrics.description: When postdoctoral researchers are supported, a mentoring plan may be required as special supplementary documentation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include a mentoring plan that addresses career development and mentoring activities consistent with PAPPG instructions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Plans for Data Management and Sharing of Research Products
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposals must include plans for data management and sharing of the products of research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe how data, software, and other products will be managed and shared; follow PAPPG guidance on content and expectations for data management plans.

rubrics_metrics.name: Documentation of Collaborative Arrangements (letters of collaboration)
rubrics_metrics.description: Collaborative arrangements of significance should be documented through letters of collaboration or similar documentation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include letters when required to document commitments; letters should describe the nature and extent of the collaboration without creating contractual obligations inconsistent with proposal content.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appendices and Supplementary Documentation (limits and allowed content)
rubrics_metrics.description: Appendices are allowed only as specified and must conform to PAPPG limits on content and length.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not use appendices to circumvent page limits; include only materials explicitly permitted by PAPPG or program solicitation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Special Processing Instructions and Proprietary/Privileged Information
rubrics_metrics.description: Instructions exist for handling proprietary or privileged information included in proposals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow PAPPG procedures for marking proprietary information and the process NSF uses to handle such information; misuse may affect review or disclosure.

rubrics_metrics.name: Categories of Proposers and Eligibility (who may submit proposals)
rubrics_metrics.description: The PAPPG lists categories of proposers (IHEs, nonprofit, for-profit, state and local governments, unaffiliated individuals, foreign organizations, etc.) and any special instructions for eligibility (e.g., international branch campuses of U.S. IHEs).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure your organization fits an eligible category and follow any special instructions that apply to your category.

rubrics_metrics.name: When to Submit Proposals (target dates, deadlines, submission windows, exceptions)
rubrics_metrics.description: NSF provides program-specific target dates, deadlines, and submission windows; special exceptions to deadline policy exist for natural/anthropogenic events or NSF closure.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consult program solicitations and NSF website for deadlines; understand policies for exceptions and submission windows.

rubrics_metrics.name: How to Submit Proposals (system, identifiers, receipt and processing)
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposals must be submitted through approved systems (FastLane/Research.gov/Grants.gov) and comply with requirements for identifiers (DUNS/UEI, SAM registration, NSF ID), receipt, and processing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure registrations (SAM, UEI/NSF ID) are current; follow the Grants.gov Application Guide when using Grants.gov; monitor proposal receipt and processing status.

rubrics_metrics.name: Requests for Reasonable and Accessibility Accommodations
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposers may request reasonable and accessibility accommodations in proposal submission and review processes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow the PAPPG process to request accommodations; contact NSF if assistance is needed for access-related issues.

rubrics_metrics.name: List of Suggested Reviewers or Reviewers Not to Include
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposers may provide a list of suggested reviewers and reviewers they prefer not to include.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide appropriate suggested reviewers or conflicts of interest information per PAPPG guidance; NSF is not bound to use suggested reviewers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proposal Certifications and Certifications by Authorized Organizational Representative (AOR)
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposals require certifications and representations by the AOR or authorized representative of the proposing organization.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Certifications commit the organization to comply with NSF policies and federal requirements; ensure authorized officials complete required certifications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Collaborators & Other Affiliations Information
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposers must provide information about collaborators and other affiliations to identify conflicts of interest for review.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Complete required COA information fully and accurately to facilitate selection of unbiased reviewers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Merit Review Principles
rubrics_metrics.description: NSF review is governed by merit review principles intended to be fair, transparent, and consistent across NSF programs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The PAPPG describes core principles that guide review processes; proposers should be familiar with these principles as they shape evaluation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Merit Review Criteria: Intellectual Merit
rubrics_metrics.description: Intellectual Merit: the potential to advance knowledge and understanding within and across disciplines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reviewers evaluate the intellectual merit of proposals as a core review criterion; proposals should clearly articulate the intellectual contribution.

rubrics_metrics.name: Merit Review Criteria: Broader Impacts
rubrics_metrics.description: Broader Impacts: the potential to benefit society and contribute to desired societal outcomes (education, outreach, broadening participation, societal benefits).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposals must address broader impacts explicitly; reviewers evaluate both Intellectual Merit and Broader Impacts in funding decisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Selection of Reviewers
rubrics_metrics.description: NSF selects reviewers based on expertise and conflict-of-interest policies to evaluate proposals against merit review criteria.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: NSF uses internal staff and external ad hoc reviewers; proposer-supplied COA and suggested reviewers inform but do not determine reviewer selection.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proposal File Updates and Revisions During Review
rubrics_metrics.description: There are policies governing when and how proposals may be updated or revised during the review process.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Major revisions during review are generally not permitted; follow PAPPG procedures for permitted updates and for submitting revised proposals where allowed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Funding Recommendation and NSF's Decision to Award or Decline
rubrics_metrics.description: NSF program officers recommend funding based on reviews and program priorities; NSF makes final award decisions and issues award notices.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposers will receive review summaries and program officer communications; understanding the decision process helps interpret outcomes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Review Information Provided to PI and Release of Proposal Information
rubrics_metrics.description: NSF provides PIs with reviewer comments (unattributed verbatim copies) and has policies on release of proposal information.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: PIs receive peer reviews and official communications; some proposal information may be released consistent with PAPPG and FOIA rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Non-Award Decisions and Transactions (withdrawals, return without review, declination, reconsideration, resubmission)
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures exist for handling withdrawals, proposals not accepted or returned without review, declinations, requests for reconsideration, and resubmissions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow PAPPG instructions for processes and timelines related to non-award decisions and options for resubmission or reconsideration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Types of Submissions and Special Proposal Categories
rubrics_metrics.description: PAPPG defines types of submissions (letters of intent, preliminary proposals, full proposals) and special categories (planning proposals, RAPID, EAGER, RAISE, GOALI, Ideas Lab, facilitation awards, conference, equipment, center, travel proposals, etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each submission type may have special instructions or modified requirements; consult the relevant program solicitation or PAPPG section for specifics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Award Instrument and NSF Award Conditions
rubrics_metrics.description: The award instrument (grant, cooperative agreement, fixed amount award, etc.) and incorporated NSF Grant General Conditions set the terms and conditions of support.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Understand what type of award is issued and the conditions incorporated by reference; PAPPG and award documents govern post-award responsibilities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Grantee Responsibilities and Notifications to NSF (changes in project personnel, objectives, scope, or methods)
rubrics_metrics.description: Grantees must perform the project as proposed, prudently manage funds, and notify NSF and request approvals for specified changes (PI changes, scope changes, significant delays, subawards, etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow PAPPG and award terms for prior approvals and notifications; failure to obtain required approvals can jeopardize awards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cost Sharing (general and mandatory commitments)
rubrics_metrics.description: Policies govern cost sharing requirements where mandatory, and records and reporting of any cost-sharing commitments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identify whether a program requires mandatory cost sharing and maintain records to document commitments and expenditures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Technical Reporting Requirements and Project Outcomes Report
rubrics_metrics.description: Grantees must comply with annual and final reporting requirements, and submit a Project Outcomes Report for the general public.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Timely and accurate reporting is required; PAPPG details the frequency, content, and mechanisms for technical and outcomes reporting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Financial Management Standards and Payment Requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Grantees must have standards for financial management, follow payment request procedures, and comply with award financial reporting requirements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: PAPPG and Division of Financial Management provide guidance on requesting payments, working capital advances, final unobligated balance handling, and erroneous payments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Record Retention, Audit, and Grantee Standards (procurement, property management, title to equipment)
rubrics_metrics.description: Grantees must maintain records, adhere to property management standards, procurement standards, and preserve documentation for audit and closeout.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow PAPPG instructions for title to equipment, property use, federally-owned property, and audit records retention policies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Grantee Standards: Conflict of Interest and Responsible & Ethical Conduct of Research (RECR)
rubrics_metrics.description: Grantees must comply with conflict-of-interest policies and support responsible and ethical conduct of research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Institutions are responsible for training, oversight, and policies to ensure ethical conduct; NSF outlines institutional and NSF responsibilities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Other Post-Award Requirements: Non-Discrimination and Civil Rights Compliance
rubrics_metrics.description: Grantees must comply with non-discrimination statutes/regulations (Title VI, Section 504, Title IX, Age Discrimination, EEO, limited English proficiency, etc.) and NSF policies on harassment and sexual assault.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Comply with civil rights laws, NSF notification requirements regarding sexual harassment, and other related obligations outlined in PAPPG.

rubrics_metrics.name: Human Subjects, Vertebrate Animals, DURC, and Other Compliance Areas
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposals and awards involving human subjects, vertebrate animals, dual-use research of concern (DURC), recombinant DNA, fieldwork abroad, and similar areas must satisfy specific compliance requirements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Obtain necessary IRB/IACUC/IBC approvals and meet DURC and biosafety policies; describe compliance plans as required by PAPPG and program solicitations.

rubrics_metrics.name: International Activities and Government Permits for Work Abroad
rubrics_metrics.description: Projects involving international activities must comply with relevant policies for travel, permits, and host-country requirements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe international activities, ensure passports/visas are in order, and comply with any permits or host-country rules; consult PAPPG guidance for specifics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Intellectual Property and Dissemination Policies (patents, copyright, dissemination/sharing of results)
rubrics_metrics.description: NSF policies govern patents and inventions, copyrights, and expectations for dissemination and sharing of research results.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow PAPPG and applicable statutes for invention reporting, patent rights, publication/distribution of grant materials, and responsibilities for dissemination.

rubrics_metrics.name: Subawarding and Transfers (subawards and transfer of award segments)
rubrics_metrics.description: Policies govern subawarding portions of an NSF award, transferring awards between institutions, and requirements for subaward administration.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Obtain required approvals and ensure accounting and compliance requirements are met for subawards and transfers; maintain documentation per PAPPG.

rubrics_metrics.name: Grant Administration Disputes and Research Misconduct Reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures exist for suspension/termination, dispute resolution, and reporting possible research misconduct to NSF/OIG.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow PAPPG procedures for dispute resolution and report allegations of misconduct per NSF policy; OIG contact information and responsibilities are specified.
